guide.yujiancraft.page.0.title: Introduction · Yujian Craft
guide.yujiancraft.page.0.body: The Yujian Guide explains the survival progression and controls of Yujian Craft. Spirit Ore, forging, reversible cores and spirit tempering form its progression: six implements can fight in ranged formations, pierce locked targets, perform Sweep, Sword Array, Guard, Toolcraft and Spirit Fishing arts, or enter a fast close-range combo stance. Non-stackable vanilla and modded implements can become Myriad flying swords while retaining their names, enchantments, durability and original use. New players should begin with Quick Controls, Spirit Ore & Forging, and Formations & Targeting. Combat remains server-authoritative; camera, brightness and audiovisual settings are client-side.
guide.yujiancraft.page.1.title: Contents
guide.yujiancraft.page.2.title: Quick Controls
guide.yujiancraft.page.2.body: Every binding can be changed under Options → Controls → Key Binds → Yujian Craft. %s: deploy/recall six implements; %s: cycle A/B/C formations; %s: open settings; %s: cycle arts; %s: cast Sword Array; %s: switch Sword Array style; %s: enter/leave Combo Stance; %s: dispatch Toolcraft or Spirit Fishing. %s releases the mouse only when developer live preview is enabled and is irrelevant to normal play.
guide.yujiancraft.page.3.title: Mouse Controls & Riding
guide.yujiancraft.page.3.body: In Crosshair Lock, hold a flying sword and press %s to lock a creature; the same input still performs ordinary melee or mining. In Spirit-Sense Guidance, first press %s to launch every ready sword, steer by looking, then aim at a target and press %s to commit. In Combo Stance, repeated %s inputs buffer the next stage without waiting for the current motion to end. With a flying sword in inventory and riding enabled, double-tap %s to take off or land; hold %s to rise and %s to descend while movement keys control the horizontal plane.
guide.yujiancraft.page.4.title: Spirit Ore & Forging
guide.yujiancraft.page.4.body: Spirit Ore generates underground in the Overworld, with a deepslate form at lower levels. Mine it with iron tier or better; Fortune improves drops and Silk Touch preserves the ore. A base flying sword places its vanilla sword in the centre, matching material on the cardinal slots and Spirit Crystals in the corners. Surround it with eight crystals for the Spiritforged series. Crystals also craft the three workstations and this guide. Tooltips show main-hand attributes, current per-pierce damage and temper count.
guide.yujiancraft.page.5.title: Formations & Targeting
guide.yujiancraft.page.5.body: Aligned Fan, Rear Ring and Side-blade Fan change docking positions and launch clearance, not the selected art. Crosshair Lock retains one target until it dies or another is selected; Auto Targeting distributes valid targets inside the server radius; Spirit-Sense Guidance follows the player's view. Single Pass returns each sword after one hit, while Relentless Piercing passes through, curves back and repeats. Every sword must complete the server's minimum dock time before another sortie. Friendly fire and player targeting always obey server rules.
guide.yujiancraft.page.6.title: Implement Natures & Arts
guide.yujiancraft.page.6.body: Deploying restores the implement nature's default art: blades use Piercing, heavy implements Sweep, ranged weapons Sword Array, shields Myriad Guard, tools Toolcraft and rods Spirit Fishing; unclassified items use Piercing. Select an art in settings or cycle the server-permitted list with the art key. Sword Array needs no persistent lock: aim at a valid target in range and cast directly. Its seal has switchable visual styles including Gilded and Tricolour variants.
guide.yujiancraft.page.7.title: Yujian Combo Stance
guide.yujiancraft.page.7.body: Deploy all six implements before entering Combo Stance. It hides the held item, uses a right-arm command gesture and gives fast close-range attacks a soft preference for targets near the crosshair. Its five stages are a left triple diagonal, right triple counter-cut, advancing circular sweep, retreat-and-charge six-sword release, and an accelerated giant-sword array finisher. Repeated clicks enter an input buffer and chain automatically when the current stage ends. A long pause, invalid target or leaving the stance resets the sequence. Damage, friendly fire and finisher multipliers remain server-authoritative.
guide.yujiancraft.page.8.title: Sword Riding & Camera
guide.yujiancraft.page.8.body: Sword Riding only requires a usable flying sword anywhere in the inventory. It creates a separate support sword and never consumes the six combat implements. Flight controls horizontal movement and altitude; both arms remain naturally lowered, and leaving restores the player's original flight permissions. Optimized third person offsets the player from screen centre, uses the actual screen-centre ray for creatures and blocks, and shortens the camera in confined spaces. Crosshair, outlines, camera and sword brightness can all be adjusted independently.
guide.yujiancraft.page.9.title: Workbench & Cores
guide.yujiancraft.page.9.body: The Flying Sword Workbench installs or removes Flame, Lightning, Blight, Burst, Arrow Rain, Edge, Endurance, Indestructible and Molten cores. Material counts of 1, 16 and 64 usually produce levels I, II and III; recipes come from module definitions and the interface previews the live renderer. Hit effects share a server cooldown to keep relentless piercing efficient. Installation is normally reversible and returns materials, but re-tempering disperses every Yujian core on that sword. Vanilla and third-party enchantments remain.
guide.yujiancraft.page.10.title: Myriad Swords & Tempering
guide.yujiancraft.page.10.body: The upper Tempering Table slot accepts one native sword or a non-stackable vanilla/modded weapon, shield, tool or fishing implement; the lower slot requires one native flying sword as its spiritual core. A tempered external item retains its identity, name, enchantments, durability, model and original use while gaining formations, flight, arts and removable cores. Core material supplies flight speed and the trial reforges intrinsic damage. Each stack supports at most two temperings. Servers may disable item IDs, apply multipliers or restrict arts.
guide.yujiancraft.page.11.title: Nature, Shaping & Cost
guide.yujiancraft.page.11.body: Define the implement nature before opening Shaping. Automatic detection is only a recommendation and can be reassigned for creative builds. Shaping combines axis, flip, scale, body glow, aura radius and aura length with the live combat renderer; complex models can use Aura Only or Original Model as safe fallbacks. Confirm Shaping before entering. Entry immediately consumes levels and the lower core sword, and removes installed Yujian cores from a sword being re-tempered, so verify both items and calibration first.
guide.yujiancraft.page.12.title: Spirit Trial
guide.yujiancraft.page.12.body: Only the ritual implement may damage the trial dummy. Its first valid hit starts a ten-second timer. The trial accepts one channel from that item, a traceable projectile, or one authorized trial sword; inventory weapons, module damage over time and multiple flying swords cannot inflate the result. Potions, accessories and temporary buffs are deliberately allowed preparation. Ten-second DPS is written immediately as intrinsic piercing damage and completes the ritual before returning the player. Vanilla and third-party enchantments remain active.
guide.yujiancraft.page.13.title: Damage, Durability & Replenishing
guide.yujiancraft.page.13.body: Intrinsic piercing sets base melee and flying-sword damage. Sharpness, Smite and other enchantments, plus potions, accessories, attribute modifiers and the Edge core, contribute to live damage and tooltip values. Lightning, Burst and other secondary module damage is never baked into the intrinsic value. Flying swords have material-based durability and accept matching repair materials in an anvil; Myriad Guard spends durability faster when intercepting hits. One Spirit Crystal at the Replenishing Table restores one quarter of combined physical and Endurance-core durability.
guide.yujiancraft.page.14.title: Six Arts in Detail
guide.yujiancraft.page.14.body: Piercing supports Single Pass, Relentless Piercing and Spirit-Sense Guidance. Sweep sends all six implements through several fast close-range circuits. Sword Array requires all six ready, suppresses its target, forms a high celestial seal, rains sword-qi and ends with a giant sword; it completes even after an early kill. Myriad Guard intercepts by direction, reflects damage and transmits installed core effects. Each Toolcraft input dispatches one ready tool under vanilla mining rules. Spirit Fishing supports multiple rods, inherits Luck, Luck of the Sea and Lure, and returns loot to inventory.
guide.yujiancraft.page.15.title: Settings, Servers & Troubleshooting
guide.yujiancraft.page.15.body: Client settings store camera, crosshair, sound, brightness and local visuals; shader detection selects a softer brightness profile automatically. World serverconfig files own damage, range, cooldowns, art multipliers and the Myriad item catalogue, and administrators can hot-reload them with /yujiancraft reload. Client and server should run the same mod version. For crashes, reproduce on plain Forge and submit latest.log or the crash report with Minecraft, Forge, Java, modpack and shader versions. Remove tokens, server addresses and personal paths first. Bright flashes may cause discomfort and can be disabled in settings.
